name: Get Spreadsheet
description: Get the values of a specified Excel worksheet. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/range-get?view=graph-rest-1.0&tabs=http)

configurable_props.name: folderId
configurable_props.label: Folder ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the folder where the item is located

configurable_props.name: sheetId
configurable_props.label: Sheet ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the spreadsheet you want to use

configurable_props.name: worksheet
configurable_props.label: Worksheet
configurable_props.description: The name of the worksheet to use

configurable_props.name: range
configurable_props.label: Range
configurable_props.description: The range within the worksheet to retrieve. E.g. `A1:C4`. If not specified, entire "usedRange" will be returned
